problem: In the app, an 864x1536 photo on Flash-Next ended the process before the first token ("Interrupted."). lmkd killed Equity in the foreground at 09:56:36 (killinfo: RSS 2.47 GiB, about 200 MB free) after killing most other processes; a second attempt died the same way at 10:00:21.
cause: Equity creates the mtmd context without a warmup, and mtmd resolves flash_attn "auto" only in its warmup: the CPU encoder ran plain attention, whose KQ matrix is 16 heads x 4,096^2 floats (about 1 GiB) at a 1,024-token image, beyond the 128 MiB the app reserved.
fix: vision_flash_attn (default true) sets flash attention for the CPU encoder; the app reserves 256 MiB of encoder work.
